006package dev.metaschema.core.datatype.markup;
007
008import com.vladsch.flexmark.html.HtmlRenderer;
009import com.vladsch.flexmark.parser.Parser;
010import com.vladsch.flexmark.util.ast.Block;
011import com.vladsch.flexmark.util.ast.Document;
012import com.vladsch.flexmark.util.ast.Node;
013import com.vladsch.flexmark.util.data.DataSet;
014import com.vladsch.flexmark.util.data.MutableDataSet;
015import com.vladsch.flexmark.util.misc.Extension;
016
017import java.util.Collection;
018import java.util.LinkedList;
019import java.util.List;
020
021import dev.metaschema.core.datatype.markup.flexmark.FlexmarkFactory;
022import dev.metaschema.core.datatype.markup.flexmark.impl.FlexmarkConfiguration;
023import dev.metaschema.core.datatype.markup.flexmark.impl.SuppressPTagExtension;
024import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
025
026/**
027 * Supports a data value which is a single line of markup.
028 * <p>
029 * This markup can be presented as XHTML or Markdown.
030 */
031public final class MarkupLine
032    extends AbstractMarkupString<MarkupLine> {
033
034  @NonNull
035  private static final DataSet FLEXMARK_CONFIG = newParserOptions();
036
037  @NonNull
038  private static final FlexmarkFactory FLEXMARK_FACTORY = FlexmarkFactory.newInstance(FLEXMARK_CONFIG);
039
040  @SuppressWarnings("null")
041  @NonNull
042  private static DataSet newParserOptions() {
043    MutableDataSet options = new MutableDataSet();
044    // disable inline HTML
045    options.set(Parser.HTML_BLOCK_PARSER, false);
046    // disable list processing
047    options.set(Parser.LIST_BLOCK_PARSER, false);
048    options.set(HtmlRenderer.SUPPRESS_HTML_BLOCKS, true);
049
050    Collection<Extension> currentExtensions = Parser.EXTENSIONS.get(FlexmarkConfiguration.instance());
051    List<Extension> extensions = new LinkedList<>(currentExtensions);
052    extensions.add(SuppressPTagExtension.newInstance());
053    Parser.EXTENSIONS.set(options, extensions);
054
055    return FlexmarkConfiguration.newFlexmarkConfig(options);
056  }
057
058  /**
059   * Convert the provided HTML string into markup.
060   *
061   * @param html
062   *          the HTML
063   * @return the markup instance
064   */
065  @NonNull
066  public static MarkupLine fromHtml(@NonNull String html) {
067    return new MarkupLine(
068        parseHtml(html, FLEXMARK_FACTORY.getFlexmarkHtmlConverter(), FLEXMARK_FACTORY.getMarkdownParser()));
069  }
070
071  /**
072   * Convert the provided markdown string into markup.
073   *
074   * @param markdown
075   *          the markup
076   * @return the markup instance
077   */
078  @NonNull
079  public static MarkupLine fromMarkdown(@NonNull String markdown) {
080    return new MarkupLine(parseMarkdown(markdown, FLEXMARK_FACTORY.getMarkdownParser()));
081  }
082
083  @Override
084  public FlexmarkFactory getFlexmarkFactory() {
085    return FLEXMARK_FACTORY;
086  }
087
088  /**
089   * Construct a new single line markup instance.
090   *
091   * @param astNode
092   *          the parsed markup AST
093   */
094  protected MarkupLine(@NonNull Document astNode) {
095    super(astNode);
096    Node child = astNode.getFirstChild();
097    if (child instanceof Block && child.getNext() != null) {
098      throw new IllegalStateException("multiple blocks not allowed");
099    } // else empty markdown
100  }
101
102  @Override
103  public MarkupLine copy() {
104    // TODO: find a way to do a deep copy
105    // this is a shallow copy that uses the same underlying Document object
106    return new MarkupLine(getDocument());
107  }
108
109  @Override
110  public boolean isBlock() {
111    return false;
112  }
113}
